Harper Kim: hi all 1st day in eng-infra! laptop arrived but disk encryption setup asks for a recovery key I don't have. Anyone know where to find that? Also quick intro: I brew terrible coffee but promise to improve.

Noel Chen: welcome @Harper! recovery key is generated during imaging and stored in 1Password under Devices > Harper Kim. If it's not there, ping IT Support Bot with the asset tag. Also join #eng-infra and #devex.

IT Support Bot: Ticket created: IT-9001. Please provide asset tag and OS version. If 1Password entry missing, confirm your full name as shown in HR.

Harper Kim: asset ASSET-8832, macOS 14.3. I checked 1Password and no Devices entry yet.

Maya Diaz: hey Harper 403 welcome! Im your onboarding buddy, I can walk you through the infra repo later. For now if you need to code, we have a preregistered devbox you can use: ssh harper@devbox-07.redwood.ai (creds in 1Password).

People Ops Bot: Welcome Harper! Lunch on Friday at 12:30 for new hires. Please fill out the workstation preferences form sent via DM.

Harper Kim: thanks everyone 1fI'll use the devbox for now and ping IT with the ticket details. also bringing my terrible coffee to the office once i'm in-person :coffee:
